name: skyrim-turns-15
lines:
اصطف عشرات الآلاف
ليلة 11 نوفمبر 2011
لشراء Skyrim

طورتها بيثيسدا (Bethesda)
لمنصات Xbox 360 و PS3 و PC

في 16 نوفمبر أعلنت
الشركة الأم لبيثيسدا
شحن سبعة ملايين نسخة

ثم أعادت بيثيسدا
إصدارها عام 2016
بنسخة Special Edition
credits: لقطات من بيثيسدا (Bethesda): Skyrim SE و VR
headline:
قبل 15 عامًا
صدرت Skyrim
label: في مثل هذا اليوم

searched: Steam 72850 Skyrim 'Full Trailer' and 'Live Action Trailer' (940x528, letterboxed to 400 rows: 4.8x, unusable)
IGN and Bethesda assets (not reachable from the build container)
lowres_ok.result: the shots used are 1080p, full frame, enlarged 1.78x (under the 2x cap)

reel_check.SOURCE primary read: yes: ZeniMax Media press release 16 Nov 2011 (read on the Spong mirror) and the Steam pages 72850 and 489830; gate 8 Nov 2026 in the story file
reel_check.SOURCE not already posted: yes: ledger find recorded; the only hit is the SE turns-10 Reel of 28 Oct (a different angle: the 2011 release); main session checks Publer 7 days before scheduling
reel_check.SOURCE age: yes: anniversary dated by 11 Nov 2026 itself
reel_check.ANGLE hook/why now/players/payoff: yes: hook tens of thousands queueing at midnight on 11/11/11; why now the 15th anniversary; for players the 2016 Special Edition; payoff seven million shipped (ZeniMax)
reel_check.STORY TYPE items: yes: anniversary: date 11 Nov 2011 and platforms from ZeniMax; developer Bethesda Game Studios per ZeniMax and Steam; later 2016 from Steam
reel_check.STORY one spoken paragraph: yes: tens of thousands queued at midnight to buy Skyrim; Bethesda made it for Xbox 360, PS3 and PC; on 16 Nov the parent company said seven million were shipped; Bethesda re-released it as Special Edition in 2016
reel_check.STORY subject before pronoun, no line on: yes: Skyrim is in the headline and line 1 before طورتها; lines open on اصطف, طورتها, في, ثم
reel_check.STORY release verbs: yes: صدرت for the past release, no bare تصل
reel_check.STORY names: yes: بيثيسدا matches names-ar; زينيماكس ميديا and بيثيسدا غيم ستوديوز added as Proposed 8 Nov
reel_check.WRITING headline/lines/caption/X/Threads: yes: drafts in the story file; game and news word in the first five words; no hashtags on X; IG ends #ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب #Skyrim #TheElderScrolls
reel_check.SOUND footage's own sound: yes: the Special Edition trailer's score from 5.0 s, music stem only (music_only), no speech from 2.7 s on
reel_check.PICTURE footage first: yes: official Steam trailers, credited as the remaster and VR footage
reel_check.PICTURE not same as last five: yes: picture: Skyrim landscapes, no Skyrim Reel in the last 7 days except the SE turns-10 of 28 Oct
reel_check.PICTURE vertical, nothing graphic: yes: scenery and the dragon, judged on the vertical crop sheet; no combat shots, no gore
reel_check.PICTURE credit: yes: one credit over shots 0 to 9
reel_check.CHECKS: yes: what I see: landscapes and a dragon from the remaster and VR trailers (credited); what I hear: the trailer's music

decision_log.alternatives: mammoth 23 s (a body at the bottom of frame, skipped); captioned comparison scenes 4-13 s (captions sit in the crop)
decision_log.music: SE trailer score from 5.0 s, music stem

VR 5.0 s misty lake, VR 40.0 s sunset mountains
VR 38.0 s field with ruins, SE 14.0 s lake at sunset last
